PUBLIC COMMENTS
The public is encouraged to address the Planning Commission on items listed on this agenda on any matter posted on the agenda or on any other matter within its jurisdiction. If you wish to address the City Council or any of its Agencies, you may do so during the PUBLIC COMMUNICATIONS period noted on the agenda. Each person is allowed three (3) minutes speaking time. A Spanish speaking interpreter is available for your convenience.
COMENTARIOS DEL PUBLICO
Se invita al público a dirigirse al Concilio o cualquiera otra de sus Agencias nombradas en esta agenda, para hablar sobre cualquier asunto publicado en la agenda o cualquier tema que esté bajo su jurisdicción. Si usted desea la oportunidad de dirigirse al Concilio o alguna de sus Agencias, podrá hacerlo durante el período de Comentarios del Público (Public Communications) anunciado en la agenda. A cada persona se le permite hablar por tres (3) minutos. Hay un intérprete para su conveniencia.
7:00 p.m. Council Chamber
CALL TO ORDER
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ROLL CALL
PUBLIC COMMUNICATIONS
CONSENT CALENDAR
Action Minutes from December 14, 2022
STAFF REPORT
SET MATTERS - PUBLIC HEARINGS
1)
Consideration to Approve Tentative Parcel Map (TPM 83924), to allow for the subdivision of one
(1) lot into two (2) lots. Staff recommends that the planning commission:
a.
Conduct a public hearing.
b.
Find the proposed project is exempt from environmental review under the California
Environmental Quality Act (Pub. Resources Code, §§ 21000 et seq.) (“CEQA”) and the State
CEQA Guidelines (Cal. Code Regs, tit. 14, §§ 15000 et seq.). Specifically, the project is
categorically exempt from CEQA under Guidelines Section 15315 (Minor Land Divisions)
because for the purposes of CEQA, in that the project consists of a subdivision of one (1) lot
into two (2) lots, with the construction of two (2) single family dwellings and two (2) detached
ADU’s, one on each newly created lot.
c.
Adopt Resolution PC 23-01 approving TPM 83924 “A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING
COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK APPROVING A TENTATIVE
PARCEL MAP TO SUBDIVIDE ONE (1) LOT INTO TWO (2) LOTS TO FACILITATE
THE CREATION OF TWO (2) SINGLE FAMILY RESIDENTIAL LOTS WITHIN THE R-
1, SINGLE FAMILY RESIDENTIAL ZONE, PURSUANT TO TABLE 152.040.030 OF
THE CITY’S MUNICIPAL CODE (LOCATION: 3925 BIG DALTON AVENUE).
STAFF REPORT
2)
Consideration to Approve Tentative Tract Map (TTM 83716), to allow the subdivision of one (1) lot into six (6) lots and a Zone Variance (ZV 22-04) to deviate from certain development standards,
including minimum lot width dimensions, open space requirements and second story step back
requirements. Staff recommends that the planning commission:
a.
Conduct a public hearing
b.
Find the proposed project is exempt from environmental review under the California
Environmental Quality Act (Pub. Resources Code, §§ 21000 et seq.) (“CEQA”) and the State
CEQA Guidelines (Cal. Code Regs, tit. 14, §§ 15000 et seq.). Specifically, the project is
categorically exempt from CEQA under Guidelines Section 15158.3 (Streamlining for In-Fill
Projects).
c.
Adopt Resolution PC 23-02 approving TTM 83716 and ZV 22-04 “A RESOLUTION OF THE
PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK APPROVING A
TENTATIVE TRACT MAP TO SUBDIVIDE ONE (1) LOT INTO SIX (6) LOTS WITHIN
THE R-1 SINGLE FAMILY RESIDENTIAL ZONE FOR THE CONSTRUCTION OF ONE
(1) PRIMARY HOME AND ONE (1) DETACHED ACCESSORY DWELLING UNIT ON EACH LOT, PURSUANT TO TABLE 152.10 IN THE CITY’S MUNICIPAL CODE AND A
ZONE VARIANCE TO DEVIATE FROM CERTAIN DEVELOPMENT STANDARDS,
INCLUDING MINIMUM LOT WIDTH DIMENSIONS, OPEN SPACE REQUIREMENTS
AND SECOND STORY STEP BACK REQUIREMENTS (LOCATION: 4437 PHELAN
AVENUE).
STAFF REPORT
3)
Consideration to Approve Conditional Use Permit (CP 22-05), to allow the installation of a wireless communication facility on an existing lattice tower. Staff recommends that the planning
commission:
a.
Conduct a public hearing
b.
Find the proposed project is exempt from environmental review under the California
Environmental Quality Act (Pub. Resources Code, §§ 21000 et seq.) (“CEQA”) and the State
CEQA Guidelines (Cal. Code Regs, tit. 14, §§ 15000 et seq.). Specifically, the project is
categorically exempt from CEQA under Guidelines Section 15303 (Class 3 – New Construction
or Conversion of Small Structures) because for the purposes of CEQA, in that it consists of the
installation of a new wireless facility in an existing structure and supporting equipment enclosed
within a small structure.
c.
Adopt Resolution PC 23-03 approving CP 22-05 “A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING
COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK ADOPTING THE FINDINGS OF
FACT AND APPROVING A CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT FOR THE INSTALLATION
OF A NEW WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION FACILITY AND ACCOMPANYING
GROUND MOUNTING EQUIMENT ON AN EXISTING FREESTANDING
COMMUNICATIONS TOWER ON A PROPERTY LOCATED IN THE O – OPEN SPACE
ZONE; PURSUANT TABLE 153.180.050 IN THE CITY’S MUNICIPAL CODE
(LOCATION: 3669 N. HOLLY AVE).
STAFF REPORT
4)
Consideration to Approve Conditional Use Permit (CP 22-06), to allow the installation of a wireless communication facility. Staff recommends that the planning commission:
a.
Conduct a public hearing
b.
Find the proposed project is exempt from environmental review under the California
Environmental Quality Act (Pub. Resources Code, §§ 21000 et seq.) (“CEQA”) and the State
CEQA Guidelines (Cal. Code Regs, tit. 14, §§ 15000 et seq.). Specifically, the project is
categorically exempt from CEQA under Guidelines Section 15303 (Class 3 – New Construction
or Conversion of Small Structures) because for the purposes of CEQA, in that it consists of the
installation of a new wireless facility in an existing structure and supporting equipment enclosed
within a small structure.
c.
Adopt Resolution PC 23-04 approving CP 22-06 “A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING
COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK ADOPTING THE FINDINGS OF
FACT AND APPROVING A DESIGN EXCEPTION AND CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT
FOR THE INSTALLATION OF A ROOF-MOUNTED WIRELESS
TELECOMMUNICATION FACILITY ON A PROPERTY LOCATED IN THE R-1 SINGLE
FAMILY RESIDENTIAL ZONE; AND (2) A CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT FOR A
WIRELESS COMMUNICATIONS FACILITY WITHIN THE R1 – SINGLE FAMILY
RESIDENTIAL ZONE, PURSUANT TABLE 153.180.050 IN THE CITY’S MUNICIPAL
CODE (LOCATION: 4640 MAINE AVENUE).
STAFF REPORT
REPORTS OF OFFICERS
COMMISSION / STAFF COMMUNICATIONS
ADJOURNMENT
CERTIFICATION
I, Ron Garcia, Planning Commission Secretary hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California, that the foregoing agenda was posted on the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting.
PLEASE NOTE: Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to each item on this agenda are available for public viewing and inspection at City Hall, 14403 E. Pacific Avenue, 2nd Floor Lobby Area or at the Los Angeles County Public Library in the City of Baldwin Park, 4181 Baldwin Park Blvd. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the Planning Department at 626.813-5261 or via e-mail to rgarcia@baldwinpark.com
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, please contact the Public Works Department or Risk Management at 626.960.4011. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable staff to make reasonable arrangements to ensure accessibility to this meeting. (28 CFR 34.102.104 ADA TITLE II)
